reason: A is better aligned with automotive exhaust catalysis: a ceria overcoat adds no PGM and plausibly improves oxygen buffering and thermal stabilization under wet, transient redox conditions, with a direct treated-versus-untreated aging test. B extrapolates fuel-cell ORR evidence to gas-phase exhaust, invokes dissolution and electrochemical tests that are poorly matched to this regime, and is not truly a single intervention because it also requires acid treatment.
